verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Apache Iceberg tables that keep data in external cloud storage you manage, in an open table format. Data stored that way stays portable outside Snowflake, and the SQL API lets programs read data out. However, nothing in the evidence documents a bulk export or unload of all standard Snowflake tables into open file formats, or a full account-exit path. Missing for 10: documented unload/export of all native tables to open formats (e.g. Parquet/CSV), a whole-account export or offboarding path, independent corroboration of leaving with data intact.
